test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Praveen and Hemant start a business. Praveen invests ₹16,000 more than Hemant for 7 months and Hemant invests for 6 months. Praveen's share is ₹1,007 more than that of Hemant, out of a total profit of ₹7,049. Find the capital contributed by Praveen.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Profit: Praveen (P) + Hemant (H) = 7049, P − H = 1007.

⇒ 2P = 8056 ⇒ P = 4028; H = 7049 − 4028 = 3021.

Profit Ratio P : H = 4028 : 3021 = 4 : 3 (dividing by 1007).

Investment Ratio = (Profit ÷ Time) ⇒ P : H = (4 ÷ 7) : (3 ÷ 6) = (4 ÷ 7) : (1 ÷ 2) = 8 : 7.

Difference 1 unit = 16000 ⇒ Praveen investment (8 units) = 8 × 16000 = 1,28,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,28,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Praveen investment = x + 16000, Hemant investment = x. Time: P = 7, H = 6. Total Profit = 7049.
Formulas: Profit Ratio = (Investment₁ × Time₁) : (Investment₂ × Time₂) | ProfitP = (Total + Diff) ÷ 2.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2ccbe0a62a593c42dead0b858dc93021dc4f7f57e39e7f1f37d7795b5cc1f43.png] 
⇒ Profit share of Praveen = (7049 + 1007) ÷ 2 = 4028.
⇒ Profit share of Hemant = 7049 − 4028 = 3021.
⇒ [(x + 16000) × 7] ÷ [x × 6] = 4028 ÷ 3021.
⇒ [7x + 112000] ÷ 6x = 4 ÷ 3.
⇒ 3(7x + 112000) = 24x ⇒ 21x + 336000 = 24x ⇒ 3x = 336000 ⇒ x = 112000.
⇒ Praveen investment = x + 16000 = 112000 + 16000 = 1,28,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,28,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Basics

Profit is always distributed in the ratio of the product of **Capital Investment** and **Time Period**.

Calculating Individual Shares

When the sum (S) and difference (D) of two quantities are known, the larger quantity is (S + D) ÷ 2 and the smaller is (S − D) ÷ 2.
